name: PortField
description: PortInput bound to a `number | null` form field. Pair it with `portSchema()`.
signature: ({ label, hint, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, ...control }: PortFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: service
props.description: Name the usual service inside the box ("443 HTTPS"). Default true.

props.name: services
props.description: Your own names for ports, checked before the well-known list ({ 8443: "UniFi controller" }).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: steppers
props.description: Show the − / + steppers (default). Arrow keys always step.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
